Our Services

Practical support for wheel distributors and modification shops

Market-ready Wheel Selection

We maintain practical fitment options for Southeast Asian Japanese sedans, Middle Eastern SUVs and Hilux pickups so buyers spend less time reconfirming parameters.

Pre-shipment On-site QC

Random cartons are taken directly from finished stock. Spoke-root cracks, porosity, dimensions, dynamic balance and coating adhesion are checked before loading.

Flexible Orders & Documents

Start with mixed-container trials, scale to stable full containers, and receive the material and fatigue-impact reports needed for customs clearance.

Why Driveline Wheels

Close to production, careful with quality, flexible with orders

On-site QC Before Shipment

We randomly open cartons in the finished-goods warehouse and inspect against a complete checklist. Factory-selected samples are not accepted.

Local-market Fitment Library

Ready fitment selections for popular Japanese sedans in Southeast Asia, Middle Eastern SUVs and high-volume Hilux pickup applications.

Flexible Order Volumes

Start with a mixed-container trial instead of holding heavy inventory. Move to stable full-container supply when the market is proven.

Reports & Export Support

Material, fatigue and impact test reports are prepared to support customs clearance, with convenient loading through nearby Huangpu Port.

How We Handle Every Order

A clear, practical process from market fitment to shipment

01

Understand Your Market

We start with your sales region, target customers and locally popular vehicles instead of pushing a generic catalog.

02

Confirm the Right Fitments

PCD, offset, center bore, wheel size and load requirements are matched against our regional application library.

03

Choose a Practical Order Plan

Use a mixed-container trial to test demand, then move proven fitments into repeat full-container orders.

04

Follow Production Closely

Our team stays close to Yongning factories and follows specification, finish, packing and production progress.

05

Random-carton On-site QC

We draw cartons from finished stock ourselves and check spoke roots, porosity, dimensions, balance and coating adhesion.

06

Documents & Huangpu Loading

Material and fatigue-impact reports support clearance, while nearby Huangpu Port keeps export handling straightforward.

Start small. Build a reliable wheel program.

Tell us your market, popular vehicle models and target styles. Mixed-container trials are welcome, and proven fitments can scale into stable full-container supply.
